name: Line Tiana Milla
source:
She was the girl who fell from the sky into Amahara after 500 years of isolation. As her hair and complexion is different than the people of Amahara, she attracts much attention. She’s somewhat naughty and my pace. Reasons for her arrival is unknown and she roams around with her talking cat Noel.
